findings.text:
## 26f313fdf812

Generator SHA256: `7860fb33fe86183a8f0898e568c0efdf569cbcdea4ca5dafd455699001429d4e`.
Rule-body SHA256: `ae0f640be2f23a3aa47222b792d47c5597d7d5c2bff7f276a220afae7a5f1e02`.

**A1 — Reproduced accepted-domain semantic coverage gap.** The reference sorts same-color objects by the minimum row and minimum column of their bounding boxes. The rival sorts by the first occupied cell encountered in row-major scanning. The rival fits **5/5 canonical pairs (5 distinct inputs)** and **600/600 sampled draws (600 unique inputs)**. All 600 sampled inputs pass the validator and match the intended reference implementation.

The generator places objects in disjoint small envelopes that do not distinguish these ordering conventions. The counterexample below contains an object whose bounding box extends leftward on a lower row, so its bbox order differs from its first-cell order.

Exact input (each line is one row):

```text
000000000
000332000
000002000
022222000
000000000
000000000
044000000
044000000
000000000
```

Actual Racket output:

```text
122
313
321
```

Rival output:

```text
133
212
231
```

The color-2 object has area 7, bbox origin (1,1) and first occupied cell (1,5). Color 3 has area 2 and begins at (1,3); color 4 has area 4 below them. Coordinates are zero-based. Bbox order yields areas (7,2,4); encounter order yields (2,7,4). The input passes both `self_check` and `strict_canonical_like`, but lies outside the sampler's disjoint-envelope construction.

**Follow-up:** Add this explicit ordering rival and shapes whose top-row occupancy does not include their bbox minimum column. Do not merely increase seed count within unchanged envelopes. Findings only; no patch to this target.

Machine-readable exact reproducer: `checks/audit-26f313fdf812-counterexample.json`. It includes task ID, generator/rule hashes, null seed/index/overrides for this hand-constructed grid, actual reference and rival outputs, validator results, domain qualification, and the command/working directory. The complete finite audit is in `checks/verified-audits.json`.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed under October 3 lightweight policy; preserve reported evidence and findings. Shared-tool requests consolidated separately. No maintainer battery/test/private-solve rerun or automatic training admission.

resolution_reason: Exact v3.1.0 repair adds interleaved bbox-versus-first-cell witness, scan-order competitor and rotation-safe lesson schedules. Reviewer reports 11/11 task tests, 12/12 required-rotation battery, 300 lessons/1500 rotations and cycle probe. Closes only the bbox-order support finding; repeated-color domain question remains separate.
